I opened PR #331 (https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/pull/331), which closes #322. It sets `reportUnknownParameterType` to `"error"` in `configs/pyrightconfig.json`.

The two `scripts/` signatures from the issue (`make_links` and `draw_border`) were already annotated on this branch, so the config flip is the only change.

Pyright 1.1.414 reports 0 errors, 0 warnings. It also printed "venv .venv subdirectory not found in venv path …/configs", so it may not have resolved dependencies. Since the issue says missing dependencies can cause spurious unknowns, a clean run with the CI venv would be a firmer check.

`ruff check .` reports 215 errors, and it reports the same 215 without my change, so they aren't from this PR.

Because `git checkout -b` ran while I was already on `conductor/issue-322`, the work is on a new `issue-322` branch and the workspace is still on `conductor/issue-322`.
